Forests in Washington State.

Source: R/data.R
forest_wa.Rd

Environmental variables collected on plots in the state of Washington from 2020 to 2022.

Usage

forest_wa

Format

An sf object with POINT geometry on a NAD83 / Conus Albers Projected coordinate reference system. Each point corresponds to a location at which "on the ground" measurements were made to determine if the location was forested or not. The data has 707 rows, each corresponding to a location and 12 columns:

  • forested: the primary response variable for this data set. The variable is Yes if the location is forested and No if not.

  • year: the year the on the ground measurement was made.

  • elevation: the location's elevation, in meters.

  • roughness: the degree of irregularity of the plot (higher values correspond to a more irregular plot shape).

  • dew_temp: the mean annual dewpoint temperature, in Celsius.

  • precip_annual: the mean annual precipitation, in hundreds of millimeters.

  • temp_annual_mean, the mean annual temperature, in Celsius.

  • temp_annual_min, the mean minimum annual temperature, in Celsius.

  • temp_annual_max, the mean maximum annual temperature, in Celsius.

  • land_type, the type of land (a factor with 3 levels: Barren, Non-tree vegetation, and Tree).

  • county, the name of the county that the measurement is taken in.

  • geometry: information giving the point locations of measurement in Washington.

Source

Data were modified from the forested data set in the from the forested R package.

References

White, Grayson W.; Yamamoto, Josh K.; Elsyad, Dinan H.; Schmitt, Julian F.; Korsgaard, Niels H.; Hu, Jie Kate; Gaines III, George C.; Frescino Tracey S.; McConville, Kelly S. (2024). Small area estimation of forest biomass via a two-stage model for continuous zero-inflated data. Forthcoming: arXiv 2402.03263 (ver. 2.0).

Wieczorek, Jerzy A.; White, Grayson W.; Cody, Zachariah W.; Tan, Emily X.; Chistolini, Jacqueline O.; McConville, Kelly S.; Frescino, Tracey S.; Moisen, Gretchen G. (2024). Assessing small area estimates via artificial populations from KBAABB: a kNN-based approximation to ABB. Forthcoming: arXiv 2306.15607 (ver. 2.0).

The authors of forested pre-processed the source data using the FIESTA R package: Frescino, Tracey S.; Moisen, Gretchen G.; Patterson, Paul L.; Toney, Chris; White, Grayson W. (2023). FIESTA: A forest inventory estimation and analysis R package. Ecography 2023: e06428 (ver. 1.0).
